even on the philosophers' account of an encompassing sphere moving what it contains, it does so through its own power rather than contact.","anchor":"الصحيح أن المحرك للكل هو الله تعالى باختياره وإن ثبت على قانون قولهم كون الحاوي محركا للمحوي","mentions":[]},{"verses":["21:33"],"words":["يَسْبَحُونَ"],"type":"interpretation","speaker":"author","stance":"reports","claim":"The fixed stars may be in a sphere above the seven heavens, or within the seventh heaven above Saturn's sphere.","anchor":"وأما الثوابت فيحتمل أن تكون في فلم فوق السماوات السبع","mentions":[]},{"verses":["21:33"],"words":["يَسْبَحُونَ"],"type":"interpretation","speaker":"author","stance":"reports","claim":"It is also possible that fixed and wandering stars all lie in the lowest heaven, each on a deferent-like sphere with the two motions, preserving the wording that the lowest heaven is adorned with lamps.","anchor":"بل إذا قيل بأن جميع الكواكب الثوابت والسيارات في ثخن السماء الدنيا تتحرك على أفلاك مماثلة للأفلاك التي أثبتها لها الفلاسفة","mentions":["37:6"]},{"verses":["21:33"],"words":["يَسْبَحُونَ"],"type":"interpretation","speaker":"author","stance":"rejects","claim":"Al-Alusi is not obliged to accept the confused astronomical measurements of celestial sizes and distances.","anchor":"وما ذكروه في علم الأجرام والأبعاد على اضطرابه لا يلزمنا تسليمه","mentions":[]},{"verses":["21:33"],"words":["يَسْبَحُونَ"],"type":"reports","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"The calculated fixed-star distance of 25,412,899 farsakhs conflicts with reports assigning 500 years to the Earth-heaven gap and each heaven's thickness, which imply roughly 1,000 years plus Earth's radius to the stars.","anchor":"وما ورد في الخبر من أن بين السماء والأرض خمسمائة عام وسمك السماء كذلك يقتضي أن يكون بين وجه الأرض والثوابت","mentions":[]}]}
